podcast.body: A track from Madonna's 1983 debut album. This song is highlighted as being slightly more feminist and more representative of the essence of Madonna's later career compared to the other material on her first record. "Ahora es mejor si que es un poco más feminista y un poco más Madonna."

Approximately five months after "Holiday," "Borderline" became Madonna's first top 10 hit, peaking at number 10. "About five months later, Borderline became her first top 10 hit, peaking at number 10."
